summary.text: Tom Leatherwood is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 99 who has served since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously served as Shelby County Register of Deeds.

paragraphs.text: Tom Leatherwood served as Shelby County Register of Deeds from 2000 to 2018, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office representing Tennessee House District 99 on November 6, 2018.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Health Committee and a member of the Education Instruction and State Government committees.
